extracted.name: San Marzano Pizza Sauce
extracted.description: San Marzano tomatoes are the star ingredient in this easy pizza sauce recipe. Slightly thinner than American pizza sauce or marinara, it's perfect for a Margherita pizza or any Neapolitan-style pie. Recipe yields about 2½ cups.
ingredient_lines: 1 (28-ounce) can whole peeled San Marzano tomatoes
instruction_lines: Place the tomatoes and their juices, olive oil, garlic, salt, and oregano in a food processor and blend until combined. For a thicker sauce, drain the tomatoes before blending.
Makes enough sauce for about 4 pizzas. Store any extra sauce in the fridge or freezer.
